shotomatic.name: Shotomatic
shotomatic.core_function_original: Hands-free screenshot automation for macos. Shotomatic captures, schedules and scripts screenshots on Mac so you can archive your favorite content, create timelapses, record bug reports and tutorials without lifting a finger. Here’s what it can do: – Capture screenshots at a custom interval (ex. every 500ms) – Simulate key presses between shots (like arrow keys or page down) – Capture entire screen, specific window, or custom area
shotomatic.target_customers_original: Mac users who need automated screenshot workflows for tasks like audits, reports, and visual records.
shotomatic.pricing_original: Free to get started, Lifetime · 1 Mac: $39, Lifetime · 3 Macs: $109, Subscription · 3 Macs: $12/month
shotomatic.value_proposition_original: Automate your screenshots effortlessly with Shotomatic, allowing you to focus on real work.
shotomatic.problem_solved_original: Eliminates the need for manual screenshot capturing by automating the process.
